name: Energy Grid
description: The site's connection to the public grid: its meter (grid-meter - phases, frequency, power in / out, registers), the purchase price (time-of-use tariff zones or the day-ahead market plus surcharge - a dynamic tariff), the sale price (fixed or market), today's account, supply quality and limits (WEM). Day-ahead prices from Energy-Charts (aWATTar fallback). The Energy Field and Heating packages depend on it.
